hardware: Per box: four M3x8 case screws and four RX-M3x5.7 lid inserts. PoE box also uses the Radxa-supplied four M2.5x14.5 insulated copper pillars and eight CM2.5x4 screws; the bare box leaves its mounting holes empty and shrouded.
review_history: First R9 independent review FAILED on underestimated X-float (chamfered PCB corners + lid post radius), unconstrained board yaw around the 5 mm RJ45 cradle during USB-C insertion/removal, and real 40-pin GPIO CON1 centerline (y=24.135..29.215, bottom pads y<=28.771). Fixed with 8 solid-to-floor base PCB-perimeter locator stops (dx/dy in [-0.25,+0.25] mm, yaw in [-0.54,+0.48] deg), expanded 39.20 mm body with rear lip behind PCB y=30.0, DXF-verified bare-edge pads and relocated bare_fins, and 163 3-DOF checks; second independent review PASS across all 7 required checks (15,466 fine-grid 3-DOF poses).
geometry_advisory: PASS at approval (479 poses, 1036 pair measurements, 0 collisions, 0 gaps under 0.1 mm, 4.5 s)
physical_test_scope: Unloaded shell fit and flush front/rear seam gap 0.15-0.45 mm; heat-set insert squareness and screw fit with no shelf or post-ring movement; measured RA023 HAT gap 14.2-14.8 mm else reprint only PoE lid; complete electronics installation; zero side-load on inter-port front stop y_stops_front[1] and unpowered bare_fin_3/4 clearance behind CON1; USB3/OTG and top-latch RJ45 cable seating; ten service cycles; sustained open vs closed powered cooling (<= 45 C PLA limit).
